static.name: regen_attunement_cast
static.rx: You attune your mind to the flow of mana\.
static.example: You attune your mind to the flow of mana.

static.name: regen_attunement_room
static.rx: (?P<who>[A-Z][A-Za-z]+) attunes to the flow of mana\.
static.example: Thornwyn attunes to the flow of mana.

static.name: regen_attunement_ends
static.rx: Your attunement to the mana fades\.
static.example: Your attunement to the mana fades.

static.name: regen_attunement_status
static.rx: You are attuned to the flow of mana\.
static.example: You are attuned to the flow of mana.

static.name: regen_devotion_cast
static.rx: You bow your head in quiet devotion\.
static.example: You bow your head in quiet devotion.

static.name: regen_devotion_room
static.rx: (?P<who>[A-Z][A-Za-z]+) bows their head in quiet devotion\.
static.example: Thornwyn bows their head in quiet devotion.

static.name: regen_communion_cast
static.rx: You commune with the living world around you\.
static.example: You commune with the living world around you.

static.name: regen_communion_room
static.example: Thornwyn communes with the living world.

static.name: regen_communion_status
static.rx: You are in communion with nature\.
static.example: You are in communion with nature.

static.name: regen_song_cast
static.rx: You hum a slow, dreaming melody\.
static.example: You hum a slow, dreaming melody.

static.name: regen_song_room
static.example: Thornwyn hums a slow, dreaming melody.

static.name: regen_song_ends
static.rx: The melody in your mind fades\.
static.example: The melody in your mind fades.

static.name: regen_song_status
static.rx: A dreaming melody fills your mind\.
static.example: A dreaming melody fills your mind.
